hero_kpi_rationale: Comparable sales are the primary growth driver for Walmart, directly measuring demand in existing stores and through digital channels, and represent the most closely watched KPI for omnichannel retailers like Walmart.

kpis.name: Comparable Sales
kpis.explanation: Growth in sales from stores open for more than one year, including online sales.
kpis.description: Walmart U.S. comparable sales increased by 4.3% in 2026, driven by average ticket and transaction count, with strong e-commerce contribution.

kpis.name: eCommerce Contribution to Comparable Sales
kpis.explanation: E-commerce's share of comparable sales growth, including online orders and in-store pickups.
kpis.description: E-commerce contributed 4.3 percentage points to the growth of Walmart U.S. comparable sales in 2026, up from 2.9 points in 2025, driven by strong Walmart+ member loyalty.

kpis.name: Gross Profit Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved by 8 basis points in 2026, supported by disciplined inventory management and growth in higher-margin businesses.

kpis.name: Operating Margin Rate
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by net sales, measuring cost efficiency.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined by 13 basis points in 2026 due to higher insurance claim costs and depreciation expenses.
kpis.signal: Pressure on overheads despite sales growth.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue after deducting returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Net sales reached $706.4 billion in 2026, up 4.7% from 2025, supported by comparable sales and omnichannel expansion.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in a context of moderate inflation.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit before interest and taxes, after deduction of all operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating income amounted to $29.8 billion in 2026, a slight increase from $29.3 billion in 2025.

kpis.name: Sam's Club Comparable Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales growth from clubs open for more than one year, including e-commerce.
kpis.description: Sam's Club U.S. comparable sales increased by 2.9% in 2026, down from 4.7% in 2025, due to weaker fuel sales.

kpis.name: Sam's Club eCommerce Contribution
kpis.explanation: Contribution of digital sales to Sam's Club comparable sales growth.
kpis.description: E-commerce contributed 3.3 percentage points to Sam's Club comparable sales growth in 2026, up from 2.3 points in 2025.
kpis.signal: Acceleration in digital membership despite overall slowdown.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions the importance of maintaining competitive pricing and responding to competitive strategies, indicating heightened competition in the sector.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions the impact of the OBBB Act on its financial results, indicating potential regulatory risks.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is making significant investments in technology to enhance its omnichannel capabilities, indicating dependence on technology.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions the importance of managing its debts and credit facilities, indicating potential credit risks.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions the importance of maintaining a strong reputation to attract and retain customers, indicating potential reputation risks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions the importance of protecting customer data, indicating potential cybersecurity risks.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in numerous countries and is therefore exposed to potential geopolitical risks.

ai_positioning.summary: Walmart did not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
